parts:
I want to add another group of legend that tells me the class

This leaves him in a group

t=ggplot(datoss,aes(fecha,X0.5um,colour=punto))+geom_point(show.legend = T)+
  scale_colour_manual(values =c("1"="red","2"="blue","3"="cyan","4"="black") )+
  labs(list(title="cantidad de particulas de 0.5um",x="fecha",y="concentracion n\ num particulas/m^3"))
t+geom_hline(aes(yintercept=iso_cla$y,colour=iso_cla$clases),iso_cla , show.legend   = T)+
  scale_colour_manual(values =c("1"="red","2"="blue","3"="cyan","4"="black","iso clase 5"="green","iso clase 6"="magenta","iso clase 7"="yellow"))


I do not like as I prefer color points

t=ggplot(datoss,aes(fecha,X0.5um,shape=punto))+geom_point(show.legend = T)+
  labs(list(title="cantidad de particulas de 0.5um",x="fecha",y="concentracion n\ num particulas/m^3"))
t+geom_hline(aes(yintercept=iso_cla$y,colour=clases),iso_cla , show.legend   = T)+
